item.name: Returns a list of Aggregated Usages

request.name: Returns a list of Aggregated Usages

description.content: Collection API that returns a list of aggregated computed usage details (there can be multiple parent products under a given SubID, each of which is represented under the subscription service line # in SPM).

query.description: (Required) The OCID of the root compartment.
(Required) Subscription ID is an identifier associated with the service, used for filtering the computed usage in SPM.
(Required) Initial date to filter computed usage data in SPM. For non-aggregated data, the time period between fromDate and toDate, expressed in RFC 3339 timestamp format.
(Required) Final date to filter computed usage data in SPM, expressed in RFC 3339 timestamp format.
Product part number for the subscribed service line, referred to as the parent product.
Grouping criteria to use for aggregating the computed usage, whether hourly (`HOURLY`), daily (`DAILY`), monthly (`MONTHLY`), or none (`NONE`), so as not to follow a grouping criteria by date.

The maximum number of aggregatedComputedUsages items to return within the Subscription "List" call, this 
counts the overall count across all items.
Example: `500`
The value of the 'opc-next-page' response header from the previous "List" call.

response.name: Successful operation
